mentions.name: RSS/Atom/JSON feed reader app
mentions.description: This app is an RSS, Atom, and JSON feed reader designed to make it as simple as possible to isolate the articles that are meaningful to the user. It uses UX patterns to make it easy to remove uninteresting articles and keeps a local record of read and saved articles. The eventual goal is to enable sharing quality content with others.
mentions.problem: Feed readers make it hard to isolate which articles are actually meaningful; this app aims to simplify filtering out uninteresting content.
mentions.audience: For the author's personal circle (entourage) initially, with an eventual goal of sharing quality content with one another
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an rss, atom, json feed reader app that strives to make it a simple as possible to isolate what articles are meaningful for you.
